summary: The Tectonic Forge is the molten heart of the Plane of Earth. Here, ore flows, pressure vents, and tectonic force combine to shape elemental stone into powerful constructs and ancient artifacts.
history: Formed when deep tectonic pressure ignited molten ore channels beneath the mountain-heart.
Forge platforms rose from the molten stone as elemental artisans shaped the first constructs.
Pressure vents expanded over millennia, creating chambers of intense elemental force.
The Forge Sovereign emerged as the master of molten stone and tectonic creation.
